copy.tagline: 记录UI组件当前与期望状态及转换
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要文档化UI组件的状态变化
copy.tagline_en: Document UI component states and transitions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to document UI component state changes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你分析 UI 组件的各种状态（如初始、加载、成功、错误、空），列出当前行为和预期行为，并绘制状态转换图、记录边界情况。
howto.when: 在 Ask 模式的 CONVERGE 循环中处理有状态组件，或重构复杂状态组件，或实现新交互组件时，可手动触发或遵循 CONVERGE 循环引用。

say.text: 帮我分析这个按钮组件的状态机。
say.note: Claude 会生成状态表、转换图和边界情况。

say.text: 记录搜索框的当前行为和预期行为的差异。
say.note: Claude 会对比当前与预期状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze UI component states (e.g., initial, loading, success, error, empty), list current vs expected behavior, and generate a state diagram with edge cases.
howto.when_en: Triggered manually or via Ask mode CONVERGE loop when dealing with stateful components, refactoring complex state, or implementing new interactive components.

say_en.text: Analyze the state machine for this button component.
say_en.note: Claude generates state table, diagram, and edge cases.

say_en.text: Document current vs expected behavior of the search box.
say_en.note: Claude compares states and maps transitions.
